learning_objective: 🎯 We will read a cute story about waiting for someone we really love to come back home!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When mummy papa or a friend goes away for some time we wait for them. Waiting can feel a little long but they always come back.
When they finally come back home we feel super happy. We give them a big warm hug.

fun_activity.title: 💌 A Welcome Card
fun_activity.instructions: Take a paper and draw a big heart. Give this sweet card to someone when they come back home today!

quick_recap: ⭐ We miss people we love when they go away.
⭐ We say Come Back Soon because we want them near us.
⭐ Meeting them again brings a big smile to our face.
